title: Explicit Veronese numerator-to-fraction map
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], S its tensor-power section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring], d a natural number and s in S_d. Put M=L tensorPow d and Q_0=direct sum over n>=0 of Gamma(X,O_X tensor M tensorPow n), the numerator direct sum of [def-sc-section-fraction-presentation]. Let T_n:L tensorPow (n*d) -> O_X tensor M tensorPow n be the exponent-commutativity, tensorPowMulIso and inverse-left-unitor isomorphism. Define an additive map g:Q_0 -> S_(s) by extending, from the n-th summand, t -> of_(n*d)(T_n inverse(t))/s^n. This is an explicit DirectSum.toAddMonoid construction. Its component maps are additive by the same-denominator localization addition identity. Evaluation and injection in degree n*d are inverse, so g is surjective by Away.mk_surjective. No positive-degree or nonnilpotence condition is imposed.

def sectionRingVeroneseFractionMap
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) :
    (⨁ n : ℕ, Γ((𝟙_ X.Modules) ⊗ (L.tensorPow d).tensorPow n, ⊤)) →+
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val
